blocks.text: Ab tak hum ne zarre (particle) ki seedhi lakeer mein harkat parhi, yani ek dimension mein harkat. Ab ek gend dekhein jo kisi unchai se horizontal (ufqi, zameen ke mutawazi) phenki jaye. Gend aage bhi jati hai aur neeche bhi girti hai, jab tak zameen jaisi kisi cheez se na takraye. Farz karein gend phenkne wale ke haath se nuqte A par nikalti hai (Fig. 2.8 a) aur us waqt us ki velocity bilkul horizontal hai; ise vx kahein. Newton ke pehle qanoon ke mutabiq horizontal simt mein koi acceleration nahi hoga jab tak horizontal simt mein koi force na lage. Hawa ki ragar (air friction) chhor dein to parwaz ke dauran gend par sirf gravity ki force lagti hai, jo neeche ki taraf hai; horizontal force koi nahi. Is liye horizontal velocity nahi badalti aur zameen se takrane tak vx hi rehti hai. Yani horizontal harkat aasan hai: gend constant horizontal velocity se chalti hai, aur horizontal faasla x yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Gend Y axis par nuqte A se ufqi (horizontal) chalti hai aur khamdar raste se X axis par C tak girti hai (asal B). A par, do baad ke nuqton par aur C par ek jaisi lambai ka ufqi teer vx aur neeche ki taraf teer vy bana hai jo har baar lamba hota jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.8(a): Oonchai se ufqi phenki gayi gend (kitab ki Figure 2.8(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Vertical (amoodi, oopar-neeche ki) harkat bhi mushkil nahi. Gravity ki wajah se gend neeche ki taraf tez hoti hai, yani a = g, bilkul azadana girti cheez ki tarah. Shuru mein vertical velocity zero hai, is liye Eq. 2.14 se vertical faasla y yeh hai:

Zaroori nahi ke cheez horizontal velocity se hi phenki jaye. Khilari ki maari hui football, cricketer ki phenki gend aur launching pad se chhori gayi missile, sab horizontal se kisi angle par phenki jati hain; inhen projectiles kehte hain.
Projectile motion woh do-dimensional harkat hai jo gravity ke constant acceleration ke tahat hoti hai.

Aise mein projectile ki harkat ko horizontal aur vertical components mein tor kar aasani se samjha ja sakta hai; yeh dono hisse ek doosre se azaad (independent) hain. Farz karein projectile horizontal se angle θ par velocity vi se phenki gayi (Fig. 2.8 b). vi ke horizontal aur vertical components vi cos θ aur vi sin θ hain. Horizontal acceleration ax = 0 hai, kyun ke hawa ki rukawat chhor di hai aur is simt mein koi aur force nahi; vertical acceleration ay = g hai. Is liye horizontal component vix poori parwaz mein wahi rehta hai, aur kisi bhi waqt t par:

blocks.alt: Projectile asal O se velocity vi ke saath X axis se zawiya theta par nikalti hai aur parabola bana kar wapas X axis par aati hai; raste ki choti se axis tak dohra teer zyada se zyada oonchai h dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.8(b): Ufuq se zawiya θ par dagi gayi projectile (kitab ki Figure 2.8(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ab vertical harkat dekhein. Shuru mein velocity ka vertical component vi sin θ oopar ki taraf hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Kitab mein do gendon ki tasveer hai jo ek hi waqt chhori gayin: ek seedhi neeche giri aur doosri horizontal phenki gayi. Har lamhe dono gendein ek hi unchai par hoti hain, yani un ka vertical displacement barabar hota hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke horizontal velocity girne ki raftar par koi asar nahi daalti.

Projectile motion mein aksar teen cheezen poochi jati hain: projectile kitni unchai tak jati hai (height), hawa mein kitni der rehti hai (time of flight), aur horizontal kitni door girti hai (range). Neeche yeh teenon hain.
Projectile ki unchai (height)
Sab se zyada unchai nikalne ke liye yeh equation of motion lagate hain:

Oopar jate hue a = -g hai. Is equation mein initial velocity ki jagah vertical component viy = vi sin θ aata hai, aur final velocity ki jagah vfy = 0, kyun ke sab se oonche nuqte par jism ki vertical velocity zero ho jati hai. Aur:
Hawa ki rukawat (air resistance) ho to projectile ki unchai kam ho jati hai, kyun ke rukawat oopar wali velocity ko jaldi ghata deti hai.
Time of Flight (hawa mein rehne ka waqt)
Jism phenkne ki jagah se le kar zameen se takrane ki jagah tak jo waqt leta hai, use time of flight kehte hain.

Ise nikalne ke liye S = h = 0 lete hain, kyun ke jism oopar ja kar wapas usi satah (level) par aata hai, yani kul vertical faasla zero. Agar jism velocity vi se horizontal ke saath angle θ par phenka jaye to us ka vertical component vi sin θ hai. To equation of motion yeh banti hai (oopar positive, is liye g negative):
Yeh zameen se phenki gayi projectile ka time of flight hai.
Projectile ki range
Projectile horizontal simt mein jo sab se zyada faasla tay karti hai, use range kehte hain.
Range R nikalne ke liye velocity ke horizontal component ko poore time of flight se zarb dete hain (kyun ke horizontal velocity constant hai):

blocks.text_alt: or R = vi cos θ × 2vi sin θ / g
or R = (vi²/g) 2 sin θ cos θ

blocks.title: Do You Know ?
blocks.text: 45° se kam angle par projectile ki unchai bhi kam hoti hai aur range bhi. 45° se zyada angle par unchai zyada hoti hai lekin range phir kam ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Ek hi speed se 30, 45 aur 60 degrees par dagi teen projectiles ki oonchai aur range. 60 degrees wala rasta sab se ooncha, 45 degrees wala sab se door, aur 30 aur 60 degrees wale raste ek hi nuqte par girte hain.
blocks.caption: 30°, 45° aur 60° par dagi projectiles ke raste (Do You Know; kitab ke graph ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon projectiles ki speed ek hai, sirf angle alag hai. Range R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ: 45° par sin 90° = 1, is liye range sab se zyada. 30° aur 60° ke liye sin 60° aur sin 120° barabar hain, is liye dono ek hi jagah girti hain, lekin 60° wali zyada unchi jati hai (h = vi² sin²θ / 2g) aur hawa mein zyada der rehti hai.
2 sin θ cos θ = sin 2θ hota hai, is liye range phenkne ki velocity aur phenkne ke angle par munhasir (depend) hai:
Sab se zyada range ke liye sin 2θ = 1 hona chahiye, yani:
Hawa ki rukawat projectile ki aage ki harkat ko dheema karti hai aur velocity vi kam karti hai; vi kam hone se range bhi kam ho jati hai.

Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke hawa ki rukawat poori parwaz mein ek jaisi nahi rehti. Jaise jaise cheez dheemi hoti hai, us par hawa ki rukawat bhi kam hoti jati hai. Is liye cheez aahista aahista rukti hai aur girte waqt bhi aahista tez hoti hai. Nateeja: rasta poora parabola nahi rehta balke ek taraf jhuka (skewed) hota hai, aur utarna charhne se zyada seedha (steep) hota hai.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Hawa ki ragar (air friction) ho to tez raftar projectile ka rasta parabola wale raste se chhota reh jata hai (pehle zameen par aa jati hai).

blocks.alt: Ek hi lamhe se do raste: ideal path, yani barabar (symmetric) parabola, aur hawa ki ragar (air friction) ke saath actual path, jo kam ooncha jata hai, zyada dhalwan (steep) se girta hai aur ideal raste se pehle zameen par aata hai.
blocks.caption: Tez raftar projectile ka ideal path aur actual path (For Your Information; kitab ke graph ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono raste ek hi speed aur angle se shuru hote hain. Hawa ki rukawat speed kam karti rehti hai, is liye actual path kam unchai tak jata hai aur range kam hoti hai. Kitab ka chhota graph actual path ko taqreeban barabar (symmetric) dikhata hai, jab ke kitab ka apna text kehta hai ke yeh rasta jhuka (skewed) hota hai aur utarna charhne se zyada steep; yahan rasta isi tarah banaya gaya hai: choti beech se aage aur utaar zyada seedha.

blocks.title: Example 2.5
blocks.problem: Ek gend 30 m s⁻¹ ki speed se horizontal se 30° oopar ki simt mein phenki jati hai. Woh kitni unchai tak jati hai, time of flight kitna hai, aur horizontal range kitni hai?
steps: Shuru ke components: vix = vi cos θ = 30 m s⁻¹ × cos 30° = 25.98 m s⁻¹; viy = vi sin θ = 30 m s⁻¹ × sin 30° = 15 m s⁻¹
Time of flight: t = 2vi sin θ / g = (2 × 15 m s⁻¹)/(9.8 m s⁻²) = 3.1 s
Unchai: h = vi² sin²θ / 2g = (30 m s⁻¹)²(0.5)² / 19.6 m s⁻² = 225/19.6 m = 11.5 m
Range: R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ = (vi²/g) sin 60° = (30 m s⁻¹)² × 0.866 / 9.8 m s⁻² = 779.4/9.8 m
blocks.answer: h = 11.5 m, t = 3.1 s, R = 79.53 m (taqreeban 79.5 m)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne range 89.53 m chhapi hai. Khud hisaab karein: (30)² = 900, 900 × 0.866 = 779.4, aur 779.4 / 9.8 = 79.53. Is liye sahi range 79.53 m (taqreeban 79.5 m) hai; kitab mein 7 ki jagah 8 chhap gaya hai.

blocks.caption: Projectile ke formulas
rows: R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ; 45° par sab se zyada

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke angle θ aur (90° - θ) par phenki gayi projectile ki range ek jaisi hoti hai. Sab se oonche nuqte tak pohanchne ka waqt bhi nikalein.
blocks.explanation: R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ. Angle (90° - θ) ke liye sin 2(90° - θ) = sin (180° - 2θ) = sin 2θ, is liye dono angles (jaise 30° aur 60°) ki range barabar hai. Sab se oonche nuqte par vfy = 0, to vfy = vi sin θ - gt se t = vi sin θ / g; yeh time of flight ka aadha hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Horizontal phenk: x = vx t, y = ½gt²; dono harkatein ek doosre se azaad. Angle θ par projectile: vfx = vi cos θ, vfy = vi sin θ - gt, v = √(vfx² + vfy²), tan φ = vfy/vfx.
h = vi² sin²θ / 2g; t = 2vi sin θ / g; R = (vi²/g) sin 2θ, 45° par sab se zyada; hawa ki rukawat unchai aur range kam karti hai aur raste ko jhuka deti hai (utarna zyada steep).
